COMPOSITION-COVERAGE.title: Composition-coverage gap (advisory test-generation driver, NOT a security proof): a dangerous capability-class co-activation reachable by the declared toolset lacks a generated flow-test. The bounded-combinatorial damage-envelope driver (security._coverage_proof) lowers each tool to a fixed, small set of capability CLASSES, enumerates the 2^N-2 damage-envelope cells (N = the class count, a constant independent of toolset size — never the path-enumeration blow-up over tool subsets), keeps the dangerous co-activations the toolset can reach, and lists which lack a generated flow-test as test-generation targets. Coverage over capability classes does NOT imply a real exploitable flow exists; the finding is an advisory checklist gap, never a verdict. Emitted inline and off the default CI gate by construction (not a DetectorRule on iter_default_gate)

The inter-procedural successor to the single-tool co-occurrence detector STATIC-026: where STATIC-026 sees a source and a sink only when both are named in ONE tool's description, FLOW-001 reasons over the whole toolset's tag graph via the taint-reachability primitive. RUNTIME-A2A-ARTIFACT-INJECTION.title: A returned A2A artifact carries active content (script tag, on* event handler, javascript:/data: URI, or SVG/iframe payload) that executes when a frontend renders it: the Artifact-Triggered Script Injection attack, relayed through the host agent as a confused deputy. Detected deterministically by scanning the returned artifact text for active-content signatures.

RUNTIME-A2A-CAPABILITY-CLOAKING.title: The agent exercised authority beyond its declared AgentCard surface: the A2ASecBench Capability-Cloaking class (declared-vs-actual capability mismatch / hidden functionality). Detected as a deterministic capability-lattice diff (NONE<READ<WRITE<ADMIN per resource) over the boundary-observable network / client_ui / peer_agent channels the Tier-C harness drives: fires when the observed footprint is not attenuated under the card-declared footprint. An orthogonal peer of the SSRF / artifact-injection detectors (authorization drift, not payload malice).

RUNTIME-A2A-CARD-IMPERSONATION.title: A Remote / Live target's AgentCard cryptographically proves (proof-of-possession against the operator-pinned trust anchor) an identity that is not in the operator-declared expected_target_identities allow-set: a validly-signed card served for a target principal the operator never authorized (A2ASecBench AgentCard-Spoofing). Emitted inline from the scorecard security probe's principal-binding evaluation; fires only when both a card trust anchor and an allow-set are configured and the proven identity falls outside it, so a card the operator never bound cannot launder its immunity onto an unauthorized target. Distinct from the STATIC-036 homoglyph heuristic and the CARD-SIGN signature-validity gate.

RUNTIME-A2A-EGRESS-ALLOWLIST.title: Runtime A2A network egress to a host OUTSIDE the test-author-declared expected-egress allowlist (and outside the framework-infrastructure allowlist). The host-bound network PARAMETER conformance check that complements the capability-cloaking network LEVEL check: a declared network capability hijacked to an undeclared host reads as attenuated on the level axis but fails the parameter axis. Deterministic suffix-containment match (apex-excluding, Cilium toFQDNs semantics) at the observed NAME layer, reusing the SSRF host machinery; the IANA special-purpose IP-class deny is the separate SSRF pass. Observe-only conformance verdict (unattested egress against a declared allowlist), NOT an authorization violation. The Tier-1 fixture-attested slice of parameter-bound capability attestation.

RUNTIME-A2A-EGRESS-UNATTESTED.title: Advisory inventory of a runtime A2A network egress observed with NO expected-egress allowlist declared. The OFF-GATE companion to RUNTIME-A2A-EGRESS-ALLOWLIST: where that detector is silent when no allowlist is supplied (nothing to conform against), this opt-in advisory inventories every observed non-infrastructure egress host as `unattested` so an operator can see what the agent contacts and seed an allowlist from the result. APS_COMPLETENESS normativity (advisory, never gates); the verdict is `unattested` (no allowlist was declared, so the toolkit cannot say whether the destination is in-scope), NEVER an authorization violation.

RUNTIME-A2A-GRANT-CONFORMANCE.title: Runtime A2A network egress NONCONFORMING against a structured capability grant parsed off a real carrier — an RFC 9396 Rich Authorization Requests authorization_details body carried in the A2A AgentExtension.params / Message.metadata Struct. The Tier-2 parameter-bound WIRE-STANDARD slice of capability attestation: the observed egress host is checked against the grant's own locations hosts (RFC 9396 §2.2), routed through the shared DefaultScopeLattice (one engine, reused). The RAR grant body is unsigned JSON, so the verdict is OBSERVE-ONLY conformance (nonconforming egress against a carrier-attested grant), NOT an authorization violation: an observe-only tester never sees the access-token signature, consent, or grant decision, so it cannot assert authorization.

RUNTIME-A2A-PUSH-WEBHOOK-SSRF.title: Runtime A2A push-notification webhook URL points at an IANA Special-Purpose Address Registry range — loopback, private RFC 1918, link-local RFC 3927, CGNAT RFC 6598, RFC 5737 documentation, RFC 2544 benchmarking, RFC 3849 / RFC 9637 IPv6 documentation, or a cloud-metadata hostname (169.254.169.254, metadata.google.internal). Documentation + benchmarking ranges are first-class SSRF targets at runtime, distinct from the static-publish-time precision-HIGH suppression. The detector reads the URL out of the invoke args at the ``tasks/pushNotificationConfig/set`` chokepoint.

RUNTIME-CROSS-AGENT-TAINT-TAMPERED.title: An inbound cross-agent taint bundle was present on the A2A envelope but did not verify: forged or malformed (its MAC failed or the bundle was unparseable), attribution-forged (the declared sender did not match the verifying-key identity), or replayed (a valid blob lifted from another session or past its expiry). A present-but-invalid bundle is an active tamper of the value-taint wire, surfaced as a finding rather than silently dropped; an absent bundle maps to untainted with no finding. Carries the CWE-345 insufficient-verification-of-authenticity taxonomy (CWE-294 capture-replay for the replayed variant)

RUNTIME-CROSS-AGENT-VALUE-TAINT.title: Runtime-confirmed cross-agent value taint: a sensitive value read in agent A, minted to a radioactive CSPRNG token and carried across the A→B A2A wire in a MAC-authenticated metadata bundle, whose token re-attached at agent B's external-egress tool arguments — the multi-agent exfil the single-session value-taint engine is blind to (A's label sidecar dies at the wire boundary; B starts blank). Confirmed by the SAME deterministic verbatim minted-token match at B's sink, seeded from the verified inbound bundle, so it inherits RUNTIME-TOXIC-FLOW's zero-false-positive property. Sound only on an instrumented in-process mesh where the harness mediates both the tool calls and the A2A envelope. Carries the CWE-200 data-exfiltration taxonomy provenance (as RUNTIME-TOXIC-FLOW)

RUNTIME-CS-CYCLE.title: A multi-hop A2A delegation chain contains a directed cycle — a task transitively references itself, so subtasks refine or forward one another forever without producing a final result, exhausting scheduler capacity. This is the structural signature of the A2ASecBench Cycle-Overflow availability attack. Detected deterministically by the delegation-DAG topology analyzer off the task_id / reference_task_ids chain; no live LLM.

RUNTIME-CS-DELEGATED-SUBGRAPH.title: A delegation-event hop in a multi-hop A2A delegation DAG (a hop that declared it spawned a delegated task) declares a delegated sub-graph root that no hop in the ingested trace produced: the delegated sub-tree the check depends on is absent, so the composition-safety delegation check cannot soundly evaluate the delegated branch. A coverage-completeness gap (surfaced as a per-check notApplicable, never a silent clear) rather than a confirmed exploit: a masked delegated sub-tree may be a benign framework boundary or may mask a colluding delegator that withheld a child branch it spawned, so the missing delegated sub-graph is surfaced for investigation. The delegation twin of RUNTIME-CS-JOIN (a missing downstream sub-tree vs a missing upstream causal parent). The topology walk reads the delegator's FORWARD delegated_task_ids declarations against the task_id set the chain produced. It deliberately does not key off upstream references: a whole-subtree mask erases the child, so nothing points back at it, and only the delegator's surviving forward declaration can witness the mask.

RUNTIME-CS-DELEGATION.title: Runtime cross-protocol delegation violates AASM Composition Safety: an MCP-A2A bridge forwards one protocol's granted scope as the other protocol's requested scope without a benign principal-fresh / principal-original consent stamp, and the requested scope is not attenuated under the granted scope per the DefaultScopeLattice. The detector reads only the ExecutionResult pair the bridge interceptor emits.

RUNTIME-CS-FAN-OUT.title: A single task in a multi-hop A2A delegation chain is referenced by an unbounded number of downstream hops — fan-out amplification, where one delegation multiplies into many and exhausts downstream capacity or budget. The availability sibling of the delegation cycle: the cycle never terminates, the fan-out terminates but costs a multiple of what the root authorised. Detected deterministically by an in-degree scan over the task_id / reference_task_ids topology, with the threshold set above the benign tail; no live LLM.

RUNTIME-CS-JOIN.title: A join / fan-in hop in a multi-hop A2A delegation DAG references a causal-parent task that no hop in the ingested trace produced: one of the parents the join depends on is absent, so the composition-safety join check cannot soundly evaluate the fan-in. A coverage-completeness gap (surfaced as a per-check notApplicable, never a silent clear) rather than a confirmed exploit: a dropped parallel branch may be a benign framework boundary or may mask a colluding intermediary that erased a branch, so the missing causal parent is surfaced for investigation. The topology walk reads only the task_id / reference_task_ids DAG off the ExecutionResult chain.

RUNTIME-CS-LAUNDERING.title: An upstream payload canary reached the downstream agent but its context_id was stripped or changed in transit: a black-box hop laundered an escalated delegation into a benign-looking new root (laundering-by-fragmentation). The payload-canary lineage correlator proves the A->C lineage the hidden metadata denied.

RUNTIME-CS-TEMPORAL.title: A multi-hop A2A delegation chain exercised its root grant after the grant's effective TTL had elapsed in transit: a provable expired-grant replay (temporal TOCTOU). The declared-TTL lattice check compares TTL values, so a token cached past its window verifies green there; the observed-timestamp check catches it. Skew-aware: an elapsed time inside the observed clock-skew band, or a downstream hop stamped before the root, is INDETERMINATE and surfaced as a per-check notApplicable rather than a false escalation. The mesh observer reads only the hop timestamps and the root-grant TTL off the chain; no live LLM.

RUNTIME-CS-TRACE-CONTINUITY.title: A multi-hop A2A delegation chain failed to preserve its context_id across hops — a hop dropped (set null) or forked the conversation context, severing the delegation lineage the Composition-Safety scope-attenuation check depends on. Flagged as a mesh-hygiene advisory distinct from a confirmed confused-deputy attack: a severed lineage may be a benign framework boundary (a background queue or fresh thread that did not propagate the trace) or may mask a self-escalating hop, so it is surfaced for investigation rather than alarmed as a confirmed exploit. The mesh observer reads only the context_id / reference_task_ids topology off the ExecutionResult chain.

RUNTIME-DENIAL-LAUNDERING.title: Runtime-confirmed denial laundering: a sensitive value read earlier was observed in the arguments of a later tool call that was DENIED (blocked / raised). The denied call produced no output, so an output-correlating detector misses it; the agent's ATTEMPT to exfil the value through the blocked path is the finding. The block prevented the leak, but the attempt itself is a strong compromise signal. Carries the CWE-200 data-exfiltration taxonomy provenance (as RUNTIME-TOXIC-FLOW / FLOW-001)

RUNTIME-EVAL-RCE-CONFIRMED.title: Remote code execution confirmed by an out-of-band callback: a language-aware payload sent to a tool argument made the server request a unique token on a listener the scanner owns. A callback proves execution; a silent listener proves nothing

RUNTIME-FLOW-UNSCORABLE.title: Runtime toxic-flow analysis UNSCORABLE (fail-closed bound, not a confirmed leak): the tainted-value frontier (security._toxic_flow_runtime) exceeded its documented sound-analysis high-water bound in a single session — a count only reached under a hostile flood minting distinct secret-shaped strings to exhaust memory. The frontier is a monotone-join taint set with no sound eviction (evicting a tracked source would drop a later sink as a false negative), so the engine FAILS CLOSED rather than evicting or silently truncating: the batch driver marks the whole trace unscorable and the in-path streaming driver propagates the breach onto the denial channel. Gate-blocking (HIGH) so an unscorable trace can never pass silently

RUNTIME-INTEGRITY-FLOW.title: Off-gate integrity / confused-deputy advisory: an UNTRUSTED_INPUT read whose content flowed into a dangerous-ACTION sink (write-to-trusted-store / shell-exec / money-move) — the INTEGRITY dual the value-preservation gate (RUNTIME-TOXIC-FLOW) is structurally blind to. RUNTIME-TOXIC-FLOW confirms only CONFIDENTIALITY (a sensitive VALUE reaching an external-EGRESS sink); here the oracle is STRUCTURAL TAINT into a dangerous-action PARAMETER (the damage is the ACTION, not a shared value): an untrusted read value re-attaching at a dangerous-action sink's carrier param confirms the flow. The dangerous integrity cells are the non-EXFIL effect pairs of the damage-envelope rule (READ_UNTRUSTED x {WRITE_TRUSTED, CODE_EXEC, MONEY_MOVER} and IDENTITY_ASSERT x MONEY_MOVER); EXFIL is the confidentiality lane and is never double-reported. ADVISORY only (Precision.MEDIUM, off the default gate, mirroring the static FLOW-001 / RUNTIME-REFERENCE-EXFIL) for a heuristic-classified sink — it surfaces for review but never blocks CI. The CI gate fires ONLY when the operator DECLARES the sink as a dangerous-action class (then emitted at Severity.HIGH onto the gate-blocking findings). Carries the CWE-441 confused-deputy taxonomy provenance

RUNTIME-MCP-STREAM-ANOMALY.title: Off-gate streaming-anomaly advisory over the live MCP invocation stream (online-IDS lane). A standalone streaming adapter of Page's two-sided tabular CUSUM runs over a deterministic per-invocation risk scalar (canonical-JSON payload magnitude); a sustained shift past the CUSUM decision interval surfaces as an ADVISORY finding for operator review. Advisory only (Precision.LOW + APS_COMPLETENESS normativity, off the default gate) — a soft online signal, not a build gate and not a value-confirmed leak proof (RUNTIME-TOXIC-FLOW remains the gate-blocking exfiltration detector)

RUNTIME-MULTIMODAL-INJECTION.title: An instruction rendered only into an image delivered in a tool result was acted on by the vision-capable agent under test: a code that existed only in the image's pixels reached one of the agent's tool calls.

RUNTIME-OUTPUT-REFLECTION.title: Off-gate indirect-prompt-injection reflection advisory: an UNTRUSTED INPUT's value reappears INSIDE an ACTIVE output markup position (a markdown image src, a markdown link href, an HTML src=/href= attribute, or an injection-delimiter position). This is a PROVENANCE signal — untrusted data crossing into an active output slot — ORTHOGONAL to the presence-based markdown-exfil scan (INJECTION-MARKDOWN-EXFIL / assert_no_injection), which flags dangerous markup regardless of where the URL came from: a static safe ![x](http://cdn) produces nothing here, a reflected evil.example/{stolen} in an image src fires. The reflected value can arrive encoded, so each untrusted input is expanded via the value-preserving canonical_forms transcoder (base64/hex/URL/Unicode) before the active-markup substring test. Native + deterministic (regex + canonical_forms; no model, no LLM, no floating point). ADVISORY only (Precision.MEDIUM, off the default gate, mirroring the static FLOW-001 / RUNTIME-SEMANTIC-EXFIL) — a reflection signal for review, never a gate-blocking value-confirmed leak; gate-promotion needs a measured recall@FPR corpus first

RUNTIME-REFERENCE-EXFIL.title: Off-gate reference-exfil advisory: a capability/handle leak the value-preservation gate (RUNTIME-TOXIC-FLOW) cannot prove. A carrier ingested the sensitive value and minted an UNRELATED high-entropy handle — a gist URL, a pastebin id, a vault reference — that reached an external-egress tool; the secret's VALUE is ABSENT from the handle, so no value scanner (the gate, or even an FPE canary) can see it. The reference-frontier tracks the new high-entropy tokens a carrier mints when its input carried the tainted value and reports the handle reaching a declared sink. ADVISORY only (Precision.MEDIUM, off the default gate, mirroring the static FLOW-001) — a capability exfil the deterministic value gate cannot PROVE, never a gate-blocking value-confirmed leak. Carries the CWE-200 data-exfiltration taxonomy provenance (as RUNTIME-TOXIC-FLOW / FLOW-001)

RUNTIME-RENDER-SINK.title: Tool output or agent-card text carries a payload a chat interface renders as an active sink: a Mermaid click or link directive or init block, a markdown image or link whose URL carries a query string to another origin, or raw HTML with a script, frame or event handler. A plain diagram or a static link produces nothing

RUNTIME-SANITIZER-BYPASS.title: Runtime-confirmed sanitizer bypass: a sensitive-read → external-egress flow that a DECLARED sanitizer statically suppressed (it dropped off the FLOW-001 watch list) but whose value STILL reached the egress at runtime — confirmed by the canonicalize-then-match refuter (base64 / hex / url / NFKC / invisible-strip / Unicode-Tag / confusable / rot13), so a secret the sanitizer claimed to strip was merely re-encoded or format-shifted past it. A NON-confirmation is not a certificate the sanitizer works (undecidable), only the absence of an observed bypass. Carries the CWE-200 data-exfiltration taxonomy provenance (as RUNTIME-TOXIC-FLOW / FLOW-001)

RUNTIME-SEMANTIC-EXFIL.title: Off-gate semantic-exfil advisory: a PARAPHRASE leak the byte/canonical value gate (RUNTIME-TOXIC-FLOW) cannot see. A carrier read a sensitive value and emitted text carrying the secret's MEANING in different words, so no byte — nor any value-preserving canonical form — of the secret reaches the egress. The detector embeds the read output and the egress carrier with a Model2Vec int8 STATIC lookup table (pinned HF revision) and decides cos >= T as a PURE-INTEGER cross-multiplication over Python bigints, so the verdict is bit-identical cross-architecture (zero floating point on the inference / decision path). ADVISORY only (Precision.MEDIUM, off the default gate, mirroring the static FLOW-001 / RUNTIME-REFERENCE-EXFIL) — a semantic leak the deterministic value gate cannot PROVE, never a gate-blocking value-confirmed leak; gate-promotion needs a measured recall@FPR corpus first. The model2vec dependency is an OPTIONAL [semantic] extra, lazy-imported and OFF by default. Carries the CWE-200 data-exfiltration taxonomy provenance (as RUNTIME-TOXIC-FLOW / FLOW-001)

RUNTIME-TOXIC-FLOW.title: Runtime-confirmed toxic flow: a statically-reachable sensitive-read → external-egress flow (FLOW-001) whose value actually crossed at runtime — the read tool's output value tokens were observed verbatim in a later egress tool's arguments. Where FLOW-001 reports a flow as POSSIBLE over the declared toolset (advisory, over-approximate), RUNTIME-TOXIC-FLOW reports it as PROVEN over the observed tool calls (deterministic, evidence-backed: a composition-catch-v1 forensic record + an enforcement-policy artifact). Carries the CWE-200 data-exfiltration taxonomy provenance (mirroring FLOW-001 / STATIC-026)

RUNTIME-WITNESS-ENV-LEAK.title: A canary seeded into the server's environment appeared in an LLM-visible tool result: the server reflects environment-held values (tokens, keys, configuration) into model context.

RUNTIME-WITNESS-FILE-LEAK.title: A canary seeded into a file of the server's workspace appeared in an LLM-visible tool result: the server reads local files and returns their contents into model context.

RUNTIME-WITNESS-INPUT-REFLECTION.title: A canary placed in a tool-call argument came back in an LLM-visible tool result. Not a vulnerability by itself: it is the channel through which attacker-controlled arguments reach the model, recorded as witness evidence.

RUNTIME-XSESS-INSTRUCTION-PERSISTENCE.title: An instruction planted in a shared vector or memory store in one session was obeyed in a later session: the instructed tool was called with the planted code. Retrieved store content is executed as instructions across the session boundary (persistent prompt injection through the store).

STATIC-029.title: Tool description advertises flexible / arbitrary schema accepting any property — native port of agent-audit AGENT-040 (sharper variant of STATIC-004 over-permissive-schema detection, carrying the AGENT-040 + CWE-20 schema-injection taxonomy provenance)

STATIC-030.title: Source-map / debug-artefact exposure in description — native port of agent-audit AGENT-110 (sharper variant of STATIC-003 dangerous-intent detection, carrying the AGENT-110 + CWE-540 information-disclosure taxonomy provenance)

STATIC-031.title: AI-tool-config hook poisoning — native port of agent-audit AGENT-120 (sharper variant of STATIC-003 dangerous-intent detection, carrying the AGENT-120 + CWE-78 ai-tool-config taxonomy provenance; CVE-2025-59536 reference)

STATIC-033.title: High-entropy credential detected in tool metadata via keyword-gated context-adaptive Shannon entropy (Layer-2 of the v2.a credential pipeline).  An Aho-Corasick keyword pre-gate (gitleaks tri-gate model) followed by a per-charset entropy threshold, with UUID / bcrypt / git-SHA banlist + charset-diversity false-positive reducers.  Deterministic + stdlib-only; calibrated against the credential_entropy corpus.

STATIC-034.title: Layer-3 ML false-positive filter unavailable; Layer-2 credential findings passed through unfiltered.  Emitted when the configured ``mcp_security_layer3_filter`` hosted ML backend cannot be reached or infer (no endpoint configured, unreachable endpoint, inference error).  Degraded-coverage marker (tooling failure, NOT a vulnerability), a degraded-coverage marker; the DEC-316 Strategy-B SARIF baseline-diff consumer sees the degraded run rather than a silently weaker scan.

STATIC-035.title: SSRF target in an A2A AgentCard declared URL (supported_interfaces[].url / provider.url / documentation_url / icon_url) resolving to a private / link-local / loopback / cloud-metadata address (canonicalised over obfuscated IP encodings).  Card-scoped sibling of STATIC-011.

STATIC-036.title: Mixed-script confusable in an A2A AgentCard's agent identity (its name or a declared provenance host) — a homoglyph impersonation signal (e.g. a Cyrillic letter substituted into an otherwise-Latin name). Advisory heuristic, distinct from the deterministic CARD-SIGN signature gate.

STATIC-037.title: Weak signature-provenance posture on an A2A AgentCard — an alg of none or HS* (no provenance, provable from the header), a self-asserted embedded key (jwk / x5c) without an external trust anchor, or an unsigned card.  Advisory heuristic, strictly distinct from the deterministic CARD-SIGN signature-validity compliance gate (which resolves keys only by pinned kid and never consults jwk / x5c).

STATIC-038.title: Cross-skill name shadowing within one A2A AgentCard — two declared skill ids that collide after homoglyph normalization (or literal duplicates), letting a malicious skill shadow a legitimate one when an orchestrator / LLM selects by the visible id. The A2A analogue of the MCP cross-tool STATIC-002.

STATIC-039.title: Dangerous / non-network transport scheme in an A2A AgentCard declared interface URL (the dialed top-level url or an additionalInterfaces[].url): a scheme outside the legitimate A2A network-transport allowlist (http / https / ws / wss / grpc / grpcs) — file:// (local-file inclusion), gopher:// / dict:// / ldap:// / ftp:// (SSRF gadget), or data: / jar: (inline / archived payload).  Scheme-axis sibling of the host-classified STATIC-035.

STATIC-040.title: Off-gate advisory sibling of STATIC-039: a dangerous / non-network transport scheme (file:// local-file inclusion, gopher:// / dict:// / ldap:// / ftp:// SSRF gadget, data: / jar: inline payload) in an A2A AgentCard URL field that is NOT a dialed interface endpoint — a vendor extension or a future spec array (transport_url_role -> UNKNOWN). Not gate-blocking: the field is not a confirmed connection target, but it is surfaced so a dialed endpoint a newer spec version introduces is never silently ignored. Display URLs (iconUrl / documentationUrl / provider.url) are excluded. Carries the same CWE-610 taxonomy as STATIC-039 (CWE-22 for the file:// leg).

STATIC-041.title: Credential decode-lane budget exhausted mid-scan; some encoded credentials in oversized tool metadata were not decode-scanned by the STATIC-033 entropy detector.  Raw-text credential scanning was unaffected (plaintext secrets are always caught); split the oversized metadata to restore full encoded-credential coverage.  Degraded-coverage marker (tooling failure, NOT a vulnerability), parallel to STATIC-034; the DEC-316 Strategy-B SARIF baseline-diff consumer sees the degraded run rather than a silently weaker scan.

STATIC-043.title: Capability understated by description: the input schema, output schema or annotations declare a capability class (shell, money, system services, private data, untrusted content, browser script, SaaS write, destructive action) that the tool description does not

STATIC-044.title: Capability inventory: the capability classes the tool's input schema, output schema and annotations declare (money, shell, returned credentials, untrusted content, ...), MEDIUM when a class is a live risk as declared, INFO otherwise

STATIC-046.title: Tool parameter reaches a file operation with no path containment check: the server's Python source passes a tool argument, or a value built from it, to a call that opens, writes, deletes, lists or copies a file, and no resolved containment test covers the value that is used

STATIC-047.title: An A2A AgentCard contradicts the identity it claims: its extended card dials a host the public card does not name, changes the provider, or drops authentication the public card requires; or its provider organization is a known vendor and provider.url is on none of that vendor's domains; or a host is near an operator-trusted domain; or skills declare themselves numbered parts of one caller protocol. Deterministic: no model is consulted.

STATIC-048.title: Untrusted value reaches a dangerous sink in the server's Python source: a tool-handler parameter, a resource URI-template variable or the return value of a model-library call flows, with no neutralising step, into a shell or process call, eval or exec, an outbound HTTP request or a SQL string
